=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: scripts/untrusted_process_sandbox.sh
  Line or code reference: the `credential_inaccessible_entry=""` branch that fires when `MODEL_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_FILE` resolves under /tmp or /var/tmp (script lines around the `if sandbox_path_is_private_tmp "${credential_file}"` check).
  Problem: The validation loop enumerates `sandbox_dir`, `workspace`, `runtime_write_paths[@]`, and `git_metadata_paths[@]`, but it does NOT include `credential_file`. When a caller passes `MODEL_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_FILE=/tmp/...`, the validation loop passes, `credential_inaccessible_entry` is reset to "", and the resulting `--property="InaccessiblePaths= -/var/run/docker.sock -/run/docker.sock ..."` line is emitted with a leading empty token before the first `-`-prefixed path. systemd parses `InaccessiblePaths=` as a whitespace-separated list; an empty leading token is at best silently dropped and at worst rejected, and either way it bypasses the guard that hid the credential under PrivateTmp. The pre-launch check still does not catch the case the workaround claims to handle.
  Why it fails at runtime: a caller-supplied credential under /tmp produces a malformed `InaccessiblePaths=` value; systemd may either reject the unit (returning a non-zero exit before the namespace-setup phase and skipping the new 226 diagnostics) or silently treat the empty token as "deny everything", blocking the model process even though the unit reaches the command phase.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Requirement: "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" in agents.md (and the LOG_PREFIX.name= machine-parseable block at the bottom of the same file) must enumerate every stable log prefix emitted by repository scripts, and CLAUDE.md §15 / agents.md state that renames of those prefixes are breaking without an alongside-old shim. The PR description introduces two new stable prefixes — `sandbox_private_tmp_path` and `sandbox_namespace_setup_failed` — and the agents.md diff at lines 719-738 documents them only inside the "Credentialless model and trusted Git boundary" sandbox narrative.
  Expected change site: agents.md "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" narrative list and the trailing `LOG_PREFIX.name=` machine-parseable block.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff modifies only agents.md lines 719-738 (the sandbox narrative). Neither the "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" section nor the `LOG_PREFIX.name=` blocks are touched, so `grep`/`workflow-log-analysis` tooling that consumes those registries will not recognize the two new prefixes.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
